training.promotion_rationale: Operator-directed promotion, 2026-08-04. Real walk-forward ablation (build_walk_forward_rows + chronological_split, matching v7's own methodology, self-consistency-verified by reproducing v7's exact stored holdout numbers before this comparison) replaced pitcher_era_gap (team-level rolling runs-allowed) with starter_era_gap (real per-starter rolling ERA from mlb_statsapi boxscore history, features/starter_history.py) -- the 'different functional form' docs/MODEL_IMPROVEMENTS.md's 'Rank-1 tested honestly' section flagged as worth trying after the additive form (adding starter_era_gap alongside pitcher_era_gap) showed the same validation/holdout disagreement tested 2026-08-02. Coefficient sign is correct (worse starter ERA -> lower home win probability) in both the additive and replacement forms. Real numbers: locked-holdout hit_rate 0.6081 (148 calls, 90 hits) vs v7's +0.6242-threshold 0.6194. Not a clean automatic pass -- see qualification.validation_regression_note.
